findings.evidence: `sed -n '63,90p' roadmap/TauCetiRoadmap/UniversalCovers/README.md` names Stage 0.1 as discreteness of homotopy-class fibres; `rg -n "^public section|^structure|^def|^theorem|^lemma" code/TauCeti/AlgebraicTopology/UniversalCover/PathHomotopyDiscreteness.lean` shows `public section` at line 22 and exported internals at lines 34, 60, 82, 91, 104, 193, 220, 277, 301, 329, 346, 359, 365, 384, 515, 541, 571, and 595 before the public API begins at line 614.
findings.fix: Make the tube/partition/rung/pasting declarations private or move `public section` down to the final consumer-facing theorems; keep only statements such as `Path.exists_isOpen_mem_subset_setOf_homotopic`, `Path.isOpen_setOf_homotopic*`, and `Path.Homotopic.Quotient.*DiscreteTopology` public unless a later roadmap statement explicitly needs the tube data in its type.
findings.issue: The `public section` exposes proof-local construction internals (`IntervalPartition`, `TubeData`, `PathInTube`, tube/rung/pasting helpers) even though the roadmap product is the discreteness/open-homotopy-class API, not this representation of tubes.

summary: The prior `Path.codRestrict` overexposure was fixed, but the new discreteness file still exports its proof-local tube and ladder machinery. That leaves downstream code able to depend on implementation details instead of the stated discreteness/open-neighborhood API.
